name: Chennai
title: Chennai: who is doing what about heat?
scope: Organisations and activities identified in public sources, read on 28 November 2026. It is not a complete list of everyone working on heat in Chennai, and no organisation was contacted.

orientation.text: In Chennai the visible heat work is led from the state: Tamil Nadu has declared heat a disaster, and its green climate company is coating school roofs with UNEP. The city corporation has trained school staff, signed an agreement with CEEW to plan ward-level heat projects, and is folding heat mapping by UNEP and CEPT University into its master plan.

orgs.name: UNEP and its Cool Coalition
orgs.summary: Partner on the school cool roofs, and mapped the city's heat with CEPT University.

unknowns: Whether the unit has been set up.
orgs.name: Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW)
orgs.summary: Signed an agreement with the corporation to set up a unit that prioritises and designs heat projects in vulnerable wards.

orgs.name: CEPT University
orgs.summary: Mapped Chennai's heat with UNEP's Cool Coalition.

authorities.name: Greater Chennai Corporation
authorities.role: Runs the school cool roof expansion locally and signed the heat agreement with CEEW.

authorities.name: TN Green Climate Company
authorities.role: The Tamil Nadu company through which the school cool roofs are implemented, under the TN Climate Change Mission.

activities.evaluation: Earlier pilots were reported to lower classroom temperatures; no evaluation was read for this profile.
activities.title: Cool roofs on 55 schools
activities.desc: Reflective roof coatings on schools in areas vulnerable to high temperatures, with training for teachers and headmasters.

activities.title: Heat risk management unit with CEEW
activities.desc: A planned project management unit to identify, design and prioritise heat mitigation in heat-vulnerable wards and zones, with detailed project reports.

activities.evaluation: The 4°C figure is a projection, not a measured result.
activities.title: City heat mapping for the master plan
activities.desc: A map of the city's hottest areas and recommendations being integrated into the master plan.

timeline.text: UNEP reports its heat mapping with CEPT University is being folded into the master plan.
School cool roofs expand to 55 schools; five completed.
Agreement with CEEW on heat risk management.

gaps: Whether Chennai has a city heat action plan of its own; the Chennai Climate Action Plan and Tamil Nadu's urban cooling guidelines were found but not read for this profile.
Budgets for the school roofs and the planned unit.
What declaring heat a disaster has unlocked in money or rules for the city.
Tamil-language sources were not searched systematically for this first version.

start_here.text: The school roofs programme pairs coatings with training for staff.

method_note: Sources were found by web search in English; local-language sources were not searched systematically. Where a source could not be read, nothing rests on it.
